decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own page, sits at the core of the natural facial care offer, and faces no visible shortfall against aspirations in a growing industry, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The hyaluronic serum is a low-cost fit with in-house small-batch production and shows no evident performance gap, so the satisficing choice is to keep it, although its lower prominence leaves it somewhat expendable.
The cleansing milk is a staple that completes the facial routine using existing suppliers and capabilities, and nothing signals underperformance that would prompt dropping it.
Launched only in 2024, the cleansing oil has had too little time to be judged against aspirations, and the slack of a growing industry lets the firm carry it while its results mature.
